facts.text: Original Resin refills one point every 8 minutes and caps at 200, so an empty bar takes about 26 hours to fill.
Condensed Resin holds 40 Original Resin and claims a domain's rewards twice in a single run.
Fragile Resin restores 60 Original Resin, and it can push you past the 200 cap.
Four Daily Commissions plus Katheryne's bonus pay 60 Primogems a day. Never skip them!
Character wish pity carries over: your count stays when the banner and its featured 5★ change.
On the character wish a 5★ is guaranteed by pull 90. Lose the 50/50 and your next 5★ is the featured one.
The weapon wish guarantees a 5★ by pull 80.
Standard Wish pity is counted separately from the event wishes, so pulling there never touches your event pity.
Paimon's Bargains restocks on the 1st of every month: 5 Intertwined and 5 Acquaint Fates for Masterless Starglitter.
Talent book domains open on set days of the week, and on Sunday every one of them is open.
Your first three weekly boss runs each week cost half the Resin: 30 instead of 60.
Elemental Sight highlights hidden things around you, like footprints, seelie trails and puzzle clues.
Teleporting to a Statue of the Seven heals your whole party and revives anyone who fell.
Raising a character to Friendship level 10 unlocks their namecard.
Expeditions send up to five characters out at once to bring back Mora and materials while you play.
The Parametric Transformer works once a week: after each use it needs 6 days and 22 hours to recharge.
Codes can be redeemed in game: Paimon Menu, then Settings, Account and Redeem Code.
Cook a recipe enough times to max its proficiency and you can auto-cook it, with no timing minigame.
Two characters of the same element trigger Elemental Resonance. Two Pyro give the whole team +25% ATK.
Two Hydro characters in a team raise everyone's Max HP by 25%.
Two Geo characters give +15% DMG while you're protected by a shield.
Two Anemo characters cut Stamina use by 15% and speed up both movement and cooldowns.
Ley Line Outcrops cost 20 Resin: the gold ones drop Mora, the blue ones drop character EXP books.
Talents cap at level 10, and some constellations add 3 levels for a cap of 13.
Taking a talent to level 10 costs a Crown of Insight, so spend them on the characters you use most.
Constellations come from duplicates: every extra copy of a character gives a Stella Fortuna, up to six.
The Spiral Abyss and Imaginarium Theater both reset every month, with fresh Primogems to earn each time.
Imaginarium Theater lets you borrow characters from friends, and it lends trial characters each season.
Crit Value = 2 × CRIT Rate + CRIT DMG. It's the quickest way to compare two artifacts.
Every character starts with 5% CRIT Rate and 50% CRIT DMG before weapons and artifacts.
A 5★ artifact gets a substat roll every 4 levels: five by +20, and one fills the 4th line if it starts with three.
Most attacks apply their element once every 2.5 seconds or every 3 hits. Players call that limit ICD.
Off-field characters get only 60% of the Energy from particles and orbs.
An elemental orb gives three times the Energy of a particle, and matching elements give the most.
Vaporize is 2× when Hydro hits Pyro, 1.5× the other way. Melt is 2× for Pyro on Cryo, 1.5× the other way.
Frozen enemies melt too: Pyro on a Frozen target triggers Melt.
Superconduct cuts Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds. The shred is the point, not the damage.
Electro-Charged keeps both Hydro and Electro on the enemy, so a third element can react twice at once.
Swirl spreads the element it absorbs, and that element can react again: a Pyro Swirl onto wet enemies Vaporizes.
Anemo and Geo never stay on an enemy as an aura, and Swirl can't spread Dendro or Geo.
Bosses can't be Frozen, so Freeze teams shine against groups of smaller enemies.
Only 5 Dendro Cores fit on the field at once: a sixth makes the oldest one burst right away.
Hyperbloom's seeds chase enemies, never you. It's the safe way to play Bloom.
Aggravate and Spread add their bonus before crit, so it crits along with the hit.
Crystallize shards have to be picked up, and they absorb their own element at 250% strength.
Elemental Mastery boosts reaction damage only. Hits that trigger no reaction don't gain from it.
Dash or jump right after an attack to skip its recovery: many characters attack faster that way.
Burning ticks four times a second, which keeps re-applying Pyro for Vaporize or Melt.
Bursts like Xingqiu's keep working after you swap out: cast them, then switch to your damage dealer.
Since 5.0, Capturing Radiance can turn a 50/50 you'd lose into the featured 5★, and it gets likelier after losses.
Since 5.0, the weapon wish's Epitomized Path needs just 1 Fate Point to guarantee the weapon you picked.
The Chronicled Wish lets you pick a target from older characters and weapons, with its own separate pity.
Original Resin's cap rose from 160 to 200 in 4.7: more than a day's refill, so one login a day wastes none.
Since 6.0, copies past C6 give Masterless Stella Fortuna, which lifts a character's level cap beyond 90.
In Nod-Krai teams, one Moonsign character gives Nascent Gleam. Two or more unlock Ascendant Gleam.
With Ineffa, Flins or Columbina, Electro-Charged becomes Lunar-Charged: a thundercloud that strikes every 2 seconds.
Only one Lunar-Charged cloud exists at a time. Trigger it again and its 6-second timer starts over.
Lunar-Bloom's Verdant Dew never runs out: it stays through team swaps, teleports, the daily reset and logging off.
Lunar-Crystallize Moondrifts count as Geo constructs, so two Geo characters get Enduring Rock's bonus with no shield.
Snezhnaya's Stellar-Conduct field cuts enemies' Physical RES by 40%, and in the open world it keeps you warm.
When a Stellar Swirl vortex explodes, your next jump within 5 seconds goes higher.
In Snezhnaya the Traveler can take on Cryo at a Statue of the Seven, which unlocks Stellar reactions.
Snezhnaya's Bitter Cold builds up as you explore, much like Dragonspine's Sheer Cold.
